patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Pega CRM is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Pega CRM only if your buying job matches “Pega enterprise CRM; custom quote only.” rather than Salesforce's shape. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than Pega CRM's shape. Workflow advantage: Pega CRM leans contact-management; Salesforce leans lead-management, inbound-sales. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Pega CRM is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Pega CRM is Pega enterprise CRM; custom quote only.; Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams..
- Company-size focus: Pega CRM (enterprise) vs Salesforce (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Pega CRM-leaning contact-management vs Salesforce-leaning lead-management, inbound-sales, outbound-sales.
- Researched limits: Pega CRM — Enterprise custom quote — no SMB list pricing; Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO..

Limitations — Pega CRM: Enterprise custom quote — no SMB list pricing; High implementation and admin overhead; Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us..

Poor-fit cases: Pega CRM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Enterprise custom quote — no SMB list pricing · Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · Avoid Pega CRM if you actually need Salesforce's motion (Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
